answer.reason: Gibbethon is more than a list entry: it was a Levite city in Dan and the Philistine town Israel besieged, where Nadab was slain.

clauses.english: was where Baasha killed King Nadab while Israel besieged it
clauses.quote: Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines

clauses.english: was where the army camped and made Omri king over Israel
clauses.quote: all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp

doubts: JOS 19:44 and JOS 21:23 only list it as a Danite city with suburbs given to the Levites; left out as list entries.
The two siege episodes are separate events, so each is its own clause.
